decisions.reason: As a certified plate heat exchanger line very close to the firm’s core offer, it is likely to be retained while management gives a recent launch time to prove itself against aspirations.

The marine box cooler system builds on established capabilities and service relationships, so a German engineering firm with broad scope would usually keep it unless clear early underperformance emerged.
Although somewhat more niche as a single marine cooling unit, it still fits the firm’s existing marine and cooling competences and would likely be kept during the initial uncertainty period.
A compact oil cooler line is closely related to the established business and likely benefits from existing engineering, manufacturing, and customer channels, reducing the chance of quick withdrawal.
Finned tubes for air coolers are complementary to the firm’s heat-exchange portfolio, so management would likely continue offering them while assessing market uptake and technical fit.
Enhanced heat exchanger tubes align with the firm’s innovation path and can support both standalone sales and wider system offerings, making early discontinuation unlikely.
